config_logger_benchmark: configure the MLPerf logger to write logs to a benchmark-specific file in the module directory
log_start_event: log a start event with the MLPerf logger using key-value pairs for benchmark tracking
log_end_event: log an end event with the MLPerf logger to mark completion of a benchmark phase
log_event_key_value: log an event with a key and value to the MLPerf logger for submission metadata
mlperf_submission_log_benchmark: initialize and log all MLPerf submission metadata fields for a given benchmark name
